page_title: Cloud Media Shrinker: free up iCloud Photos storage on your Mac

sources.entry: Photo Review - Open-source tool that lists an iCloud Photos library by size, then compresses large videos or deletes what you pick. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/danielyaa5/photo-review) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Cloud Media Shrinker
summary.one_liner: A Mac app that lists your iCloud Photos (and selected folders or Google Drive folders) by size, then compresses large videos and RAW photos or deletes what you choose.
use_cases: Find the largest photos and videos in an iCloud Photos library
Compress big 4K or HDR videos to smaller copies
Convert RAW and JPEG photos to HEIC
Delete large old media in batches
Free up space in iCloud Photos and on linked iPhone or iPad
Clean up large files in a folder or Google Drive folder on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: Cloud Media Shrinker scans an Apple Photos library and shows every photo and video sorted largest first, with previews. In Simple mode it offers presets (Balanced, Maximum Savings, Preserve 4K); Advanced mode gives control over resolution, frame rate, HEVC/H.264 codec and quality. Compressing creates a smaller copy alongside the original, keeps HDR, converts RAW and JPEG to HEIC, and carries over date, place, albums, title, caption and keywords. Originals can be deleted by the app after the copy is ready, or you can select and delete items, with macOS confirmation and a 30-day Recently Deleted window. It can also scan folders on a Mac, external drive or Google Drive for desktop, and a Savings page tracks space freed.
notable: Sorts iCloud Photos by size, which the Photos app cannot do
Compresses videos (keeps 4K and HDR) and converts RAW photos to HEIC, keeping the original until you choose to delete it
Runs locally with no account; the code is public on GitHub
caveats: New app, tested so far on two of its author's Macs
Videos stored in iCloud must be downloaded before compression, which can take an hour or more for very large files
Library can grow during compression; permanent deletion of replaced originals is a separate manual step in Photos or iCloud.com
Requires internet only to download iCloud-stored originals; price is shown only on the Mac App Store listing
